# Supported mechanics

<!-- Generated by `rake docs` from the primitive registry. Do not edit. -->

Rules version: Comprehensive Rules effective 2026-11-06.

## Card types

| Name | Rules | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| [`artifact`](docs/reference/types.md#artifact) | 301.1 | A permanent cast at sorcery speed. |
| [`creature`](docs/reference/types.md#creature) | 302.1, 302.4, 302.6, 307.1 | A permanent with power and toughness that can attack and block. Cast at sorcery speed. It can't attack or use {T} abilities unless controlled continuously since its controller's most recent turn began (summoning sickness). |
| [`enchantment`](docs/reference/types.md#enchantment) | 303.1 | A permanent cast at sorcery speed. |
| [`instant`](docs/reference/types.md#instant) | 304.1, 304.2, 608.2n | A spell cast any time its controller has priority. Its spell ability resolves, then it goes to the graveyard. |
| [`kindred`](docs/reference/types.md#kindred) | 308.1, 308.2, 205.3m | A card type that goes with another one ("Kindred Sorcery — Goblin"): the card is cast and resolves as its other type, and its subtypes are creature types. |
| [`land`](docs/reference/types.md#land) | 305.1, 305.2, 305.3, 202.1a | A permanent played with the special action "play a land" (one per turn, main phase, empty stack). It has no mana cost. |
| [`planeswalker`](docs/reference/types.md#planeswalker) | 306.5b, 306.8, 120.3c, 606.3, 704.5i | A permanent that enters with loyalty counters equal to its printed loyalty. Its loyalty abilities can be activated at sorcery speed, one per turn. Damage dealt to it removes loyalty counters; at 0 loyalty it is put into its owner's graveyard. |
| [`sorcery`](docs/reference/types.md#sorcery) | 307.1, 307.2, 608.2n | A spell cast only in its controller's main phase while the stack is empty. |

## Supertypes

| Name | Rules | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| [`basic`](docs/reference/supertypes.md#basic) | 205.4c, 100.2a | Basic cards are exempt from the four-copies deck construction limit. |
| [`legendary`](docs/reference/supertypes.md#legendary) | 205.4d, 704.5j | If a player controls two or more legendary permanents with the same name, they choose one and put the rest into their owners' graveyards (the legend rule). |

| [`equipment`](docs/reference/subtypes.md#equipment) | 301.5, 301.5b, 301.5c, 704.5n | An artifact that can be attached to a creature (it enters unattached). If the creature it equips stops being a creature or leaves, it becomes unattached and stays on the battlefield (a state-based action). |

| [`mountain`](docs/reference/subtypes.md#mountain) | 305.6, 205.3i | Basic land type. A land with this subtype has "{T}: Add {R}." |
| [`plains`](docs/reference/subtypes.md#plains) | 305.6, 205.3i | Basic land type. A land with this subtype has "{T}: Add {W}." |

A Saga enters with a lore counter; as its controller's precombat main phase begins, they put another lore counter on it. Each lore counter added can trigger its chapter abilities. Once its lore counters reach its final chapter number and no chapter ability of it is waiting to resolve, its controller sacrifices it. |
| [`swamp`](docs/reference/subtypes.md#swamp) | 305.6, 205.3i | Basic land type. A land with this subtype has "{T}: Add {B}." |

| [`becomes_blocked`](docs/reference/triggers.md#becomes_blocked) | 509.3c, 509.1h, 603.2e | The subject becomes blocked: once per combat when blockers are declared, even if several creatures block it. |
| [`becomes_crewed`](docs/reference/triggers.md#becomes_crewed) | 702.122e, 603.2 | A crew ability of the subject resolves (it becomes crewed). |
| [`becomes_level`](docs/reference/triggers.md#becomes_level) | 717.2a, 603.2 | This permanent's level becomes `level` (a class level bar's ability resolves). |
| [`becomes_tapped`](docs/reference/triggers.md#becomes_tapped) | 603.2e, 701.26a | The subject becomes tapped (for any reason: a cost, attacking, an effect). A permanent that enters tapped doesn't become tapped. |
| [`becomes_target`](docs/reference/triggers.md#becomes_target) | 115.1, 601.2c, 603.2, 603.2c | The subject becomes the target of a spell or ability (controlled by `by`: opponent | you | any (default), relative to the source's controller). One trigger per matching object targeted. |
| [`becomes_untapped`](docs/reference/triggers.md#becomes_untapped) | 603.2e, 701.26b | The subject becomes untapped (in the untap step or by an effect). A permanent that enters untapped doesn't become untapped. |
| [`cast`](docs/reference/triggers.md#cast) | 603.2, 601.2i, 113.6, 202.3e, 201.4, 607.2 | A player casts a spell. `controller`: you (default) | opponent | any; `spell`: creature | noncreature | instant_or_sorcery, or any spell filter, e.g. {"spell": {"subtypes": ["saga"]}} or {"one_of": [...]} for "creature or Spacecraft spell"; `name` / `mana_value`: "chosen" (the source's as-it-entered choice); `self: true`: "when you cast this spell" (it functions on the stack). |
| [`counters_placed`](docs/reference/triggers.md#counters_placed) | 122.6, 603.2, 603.2c | One or more counters (only `counter`, if given) are put on the subject, including the counters it enters the battlefield with. Triggers once per event, however many counters. |
| [`crews_vehicle`](docs/reference/triggers.md#crews_vehicle) | 702.122b, 603.2 | The subject (a creature) crews a Vehicle: it's tapped to pay that Vehicle's crew cost. {"triggering": "object"} is the Vehicle. |
| [`cycles`](docs/reference/triggers.md#cycles) | 702.29a, 702.29e | A player (`controller`: you (default) | opponent | any) cycles a card (activates its cycling or typecycling ability; optional `card` filter). |

Triggers once per damage event (each combat damage step is one, so double strike can trigger twice). |
| [`dies`](docs/reference/triggers.md#dies) | 603.6c, 603.10a, 700.4 | The subject is put into a graveyard from the battlefield. Looks back in time (CR 603.10a). |
| [`discards`](docs/reference/triggers.md#discards) | 701.9a, 603.2c, 702.29d | A player (`controller`: you (default) | opponent | any) discards a card (optional `card` filter). `batched: true`: "one or more cards", once per event batch; then "that many" is how many were discarded. |
| [`draws`](docs/reference/triggers.md#draws) | 121.1, 121.2 | A player draws a card; triggers once per card (draws happen one at a time). `controller`: you (default) | opponent | any. |
| [`enters`](docs/reference/triggers.md#enters) | 603.6a, 603.2, 614.12 | The subject enters the battlefield. `untapped: true`: only if it entered untapped. |
| [`faces_dilemma`](docs/reference/triggers.md#faces_dilemma) | 700.17, 700.2, 601.2b, 603.3c | A player faces a dilemma: they chose one or more modes for a spell or ability (cast, activated, or a triggered ability put on the stack). `controller`: you (default) | opponent | any. CR 700.17. |
| [`gains_life`](docs/reference/triggers.md#gains_life) | 119.9, 120.3f | A player gains life (once per life gain event; lifelink combat damage is one event per source). `controller`: you (default) | opponent | any. |
| [`leaves_battlefield`](docs/reference/triggers.md#leaves_battlefield) | 603.6c, 603.10a, 400.7 | The subject leaves the battlefield (for any zone, or only `to` that zone). Looks back in time: the permanent is matched as it last existed (types, controller, counters). |
| [`leaves_graveyard`](docs/reference/triggers.md#leaves_graveyard) | 603.10a, 603.2c, 404.1 | A card leaves a graveyard (whose: `controller` you (default) | opponent | any). | [`loses_life`](docs/reference/triggers.md#loses_life) | 119.3, 120.3a | A player loses life (damage to a player is life loss, CR 120.3a). `controller`: you (default) | opponent | any. |
| [`player_attacks`](docs/reference/triggers.md#player_attacks) | 508.3d, 508.1 | A player declares one or more attackers (once per combat, not per creature). `controller`: you (default) | opponent | any. |
| [`put_into`](docs/reference/triggers.md#put_into) | 603.6c, 603.2c, 400.3 | A card is put into `zone` (graveyard | exile) from anywhere, or only `from` the listed zones. `controller`: the card's owner (you (default) | opponent | any); optional `card` filter on the card. `batched: true`: "one or more cards", once per event batch. With "battlefield" among `from` it looks back in time like leaves_battlefield. |
| [`sacrifices`](docs/reference/triggers.md#sacrifices) | 701.21a, 603.10a, 603.2c | The subject is sacrificed (`controller` of the subject: who sacrificed it). Looks back in time, like leaves_battlefield. `batched: true`: "one or more", once per event batch. |
| [`scries`](docs/reference/triggers.md#scries) | 701.22a, 701.22b | A player (`controller`: you (default) | opponent | any) scries (not scry 0). Triggers after the scry is complete. |
| [`step_begins`](docs/reference/triggers.md#step_begins) | 603.6b, 503.1a, 513.1a | A step begins. `whose`: "your" (default), "each" or "opponent". |
| [`surveils`](docs/reference/triggers.md#surveils) | 701.25a, 701.25c, 701.25d | A player (`controller`: you (default) | opponent | any) surveils (not surveil 0). Triggers after the surveil is complete. |
| [`transforms`](docs/reference/triggers.md#transforms) | 701.27f, 603.2 | The subject transforms. For the default subject (this permanent), the ability is on the face that's up afterward, so it means "whenever this transforms into [this face]". |

It keeps its counters, status and other effects; nothing enters or leaves, so no enter or leave abilities trigger. Several copy effects apply in timestamp order. |

| [`creature`](docs/reference/filters.md#creature) | 115.1 | A creature on the battlefield. |

| [`one_of`](docs/reference/filters.md#one_of) | 115.1, 109.2 | Anything at least one of the listed filters matches (each may have restrictions). |

| [`planeswalker`](docs/reference/filters.md#planeswalker) | 115.1 | A planeswalker on the battlefield. |
| [`player`](docs/reference/filters.md#player) | 115.1 | A player. |

## Counters with rules

| Name | Rules | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| [`+1/+1`](docs/reference/counters.md#+1/+1) | 122.1a, 122.3, 613.4c, 704.5q | Adds 1 to power and toughness (layer 7c). Any +X/+Y or -X/-Y counter works the same way. If a permanent has both +1/+1 and -1/-1 counters, N of each are removed as a state-based action (N = the smaller count). |
| [`-1/-1`](docs/reference/counters.md#-1/-1) | 122.1a, 122.3, 613.4c, 704.5q | Subtracts 1 from power and toughness (layer 7c). |
| [`finality`](docs/reference/counters.md#finality) | 122.1h, 614.1a | If the permanent would be put into a graveyard from the battlefield, it is exiled instead. |
| [`keyword`](docs/reference/counters.md#keyword) | 122.1b, 613.1f | A counter named after a keyword (flying, first_strike, double_strike, deathtouch, haste, hexproof, indestructible, lifelink, menace, reach, trample, vigilance) gives the permanent that keyword (layer 6). Write the keyword itself as the counter name. |
| [`loyalty`](docs/reference/counters.md#loyalty) | 122.1e, 306.5b, 704.5i | A planeswalker's loyalty; at 0 it is put into its owner's graveyard. |
| [`shield`](docs/reference/counters.md#shield) | 122.1c, 614.1a, 615.1a, 701.8b | If the permanent would be destroyed by an effect, instead remove a shield counter. If damage would be dealt to it, prevent it and remove a shield counter (simultaneous damage, such as combat damage, removes only one). |
| [`stun`](docs/reference/counters.md#stun) | 122.1d, 502.3, 701.26b | If the permanent would become untapped (untap step or an effect), instead one stun counter is removed from it. |
